headline: Peru Signs Concession Addendum to Expand Natural Gas Distribution
summary: The Peruvian Society of Hydrocarbons welcomed the signing of a concession addendum with Cálidda to expand natural gas distribution to seven central and southern regions.
why: Gas distribution infrastructure expansions increase regional access to cleaner energy and lower domestic energy costs.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Expanded gas distribution infrastructure supports regional economic development and energy access.
